title: docs(objectql,spec): the tenant column is stamped and never NULL on single-tenant stacks (C1)
body:
This PR carries **item C1 only** of #25128. Item B6 (narrowing the blanket pre-18 relax rigs) moved to #25132 under the claim's split; #25132 is not addressed here.

Fixes #25128

Clause-②: no (comment and docblock text only: no accept set, response, status, error, outcome or export moves)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

Since 7b-0 (#24940, merged as `5e9b100743`), a table the driver creates carries its tenant column (`organization_id`) NOT NULL, and an insert is stamped (under `single` with the Default Organization). Three comments still said the column stays NULL on single-tenant stacks. Each now uses the wording 7b-0 used for the two sites it corrected (`applySystemFields`' docblock in `registry.ts` and `SystemFieldName.ORGANIZATION_ID` in `system-names.ts`): org-scoping stamps it on insert (under `single` with the Default Organization), and it is never NULL (ADR-0131 D1). Each comment keeps the rest of what it said; in particular the INDEX is still gated on multi-tenant mode.

| File | Site | +/- |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` | the comment at the `organization_id` gate in `applySystemFields` ("it just stays NULL when no tenant context exists") | +3 / -2 |
| `packages/objectql/src/registry-tenant-index-declaration.test.ts` | the comment above `expect(def.fields.organization_id).toBeDefined()` ("it just stays NULL") | +2 / -1 |
| `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` | the `organization_id` bullet of the `systemFields` docblock ("It stays NULL on single-tenant stacks"). The multi-tenant attribution to `@objectstack/organizations` (the `org-scoping` service) is kept | +4 / -3 |
| `.changeset/25128-tenant-column-never-null-comments.md` | `patch` for `@objectstack/spec` | +10 |

No code, assertion, `.describe()` text or CHANGELOG changes.

**Cross-lane:** `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` is a `domain:spec` file. The seat declares it to the spec seat.

## What `main` does (read before editing)

- **NOT NULL:** driver-sql `createColumn` takes a `tenantColumn` argument, and `if (declaresColumnNotNull(field) || tenantColumn)` makes the column not-nullable on both exits. Only the CREATE TABLE sites pass it (`initObjects`' create branch, `ensureShardTable`). The driver-turso remote face's `buildCreateTableSQL` does the same. Pinned by `sql-driver-tenant-column-not-null.test.ts` and `turso-remote-tenant-column-not-null.test.ts`.
- **The stamp under `single`:** `ObjectQL.resolveSystemInsertOrganization` (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`) runs after the beforeInsert hooks. For a system insert that carries no organization, it calls `resolveSystemWriteOrganization` (`packages/core/src/security/system-write-organization.ts`), which answers `derived` when exactly one organization exists under `single` (the Default Organization). The engine threads that id as `DriverOptions.tenantId`, and the driver stamps the column with it. The comment's own block says "stamped with the derived organization or refused below — never left NULL". A session write carries its organization on the context.
- **Generator:** nothing committed is generated from the `systemFields` docblock. `build-docs.ts` renders from `json-schema/` (built from `.describe()`) plus each module's file-level header (`renderFileDescription`), never a property docblock. A repo-wide `git grep` of the docblock's text hits only `object.zod.ts`. After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, `git status` is clean and `check:generated` reports all 14 artifacts up to date. The text does ship, through the built `dist/` and `src/**/*.zod.ts` in spec's `files[]`, so `@objectstack/spec` takes a `patch` changeset. objectql's `files[]` is `dist` only: after a build, `dist/` holds `applySystemFields` (positive control) and none of the comment text.
- **Census** (`git grep -i` for "stays NULL", "NULL on single-tenant", "stays null", "remains NULL" and "left NULL", plus a single-tenant/NULL regexp, over `packages/objectql` and `packages/spec`): only these three tenant-column sites. The other hits are unrelated (`owner_id` "when left NULL", nullable booleans, aggregates, `notNull`). Outside the fence, one hand-written page has the same stale sentence. It is named under Acceptance notes and not edited.
